head: codex/659-runtime-configurable-convergence
title: [v0.92.1][Runtime] Replace brittle fixed reload deadlines with configurable convergence
body:
Closes #659

Replaces brittle fixed Runtime v3 service-control waits with validated, backward-compatible convergence policy. Defaults are deliberately generous: five minutes for stop, unload, and listener availability, and fifteen minutes for authenticated Runtime readiness, with validated one-second to one-hour bounds.

Listener availability and full owned `/v1/ready` convergence are distinct stages. Stop and interrupted-reload recovery share one end-to-end deadline across service-manager identity, command, and polling work; actual expiry reports the exact stage while preserving genuine command and state diagnostics. Candidate timeout rollback restores and restarts the last-known-good configuration.

Focused proof passed without restarting the live Runtime: configuration 3/3, service convergence 8/8, strict Clippy, issue contract validation, and diff hygiene. Independent exact-revision review passed with no P0-P3 findings.
